// gcf-separate-synteny-stop-v2
(()=>{
if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('view')!=='synteny')return;
const seed=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('interactiveReviewData').textContent),main=document.querySelector('main'),panels=document.getElementById('comparisonPanels'),add=document.getElementById('addComparison')?.closest('.comparison-actions');
if(!main||!panels)return;
document.documentElement.classList.add('gcf-synteny-stop');
document.title = document.title.replace(/\s*[—·].*stage 2 neighborhood review/i, '') + ' — Stage 3 synteny';
for(const e of main.children)if(e!==panels&&e!==add)e.hidden=true;
panels.hidden=false;if(add)add.hidden=false;
const header=document.createElement('section'),h=document.createElement('h1');h.textContent='Stage 3 · genomic context and synteny';
const back=document.createElement('a');const previous=new URL(location.href);previous.searchParams.delete('view');back.href=previous.href;back.textContent='← Back to Stage 2 · models, alignment and tree';
const note=document.createElement('p');let final;try{final=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('gcf-synteny-final-'+seed.source_review_id)||'null')}catch(e){}
note.textContent=final?.review_id===seed.source_review_id?'The Stage 2 set is saved. Review genomic context, then record the final model decisions below.':'Draft context preview. Confirm the model set after reviewing its alignment and tree in Stage 2.';
header.append(h,back,note);main.prepend(header);window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
})();
